source_verification.title: 45 CFR 46.408 — Requirements for permission by parents or guardians and for assent by children
Parental permission and child assent in research on children

second_answer_attack.resolution: Parental permission is necessary in many pediatric research protocols, but 45 CFR 46.408 treats parental permission and child assent as distinct protections. The stem explicitly states that the IRB found children of this age and maturity capable of assent and did not waive assent, and the observational study offers no research-only direct benefit that would invoke the regulatory exception to assent.
